lightingGuide.ask_the_subject_to_face_th: Ask the subject to face the camera. Start with just the key light.

lightingGuide.keep_a_gap_between_the_nos: Keep a gap between the nose shadow and the cheek shadow. If they meet, move the light closer to the camera axis.

lightingGuide.optional_keep_the_reflecto: Optional. Keep the reflector farther away so the lighting pattern stays distinct.
lightingGuide.start_with_loop_lighting_m: Start with loop lighting. Move the key sideways until the nose shadow meets the cheek shadow.
lightingGuide.look_for_a_small_triangle_: Look for a small triangle of light below the eye on the shadowed side. If the eye goes dark, lower the light a little.
lightingGuide.add_a_little_bounce_if_nee: Add a little bounce if needed and check that the triangle is still visible.
lightingGuide.a_symmetrical_shadow_benea: A symmetrical shadow beneath the nose
lightingGuide.place_the_light_above_the_: Place the light above the camera and angle it down. In the diagram, the camera and light share the same axis.
lightingGuide.optional_a_little_bounce_s: Optional. A little bounce softens the shadow. Start without it for a classic butterfly pattern.
lightingGuide.have_the_subject_face_the_: Have the subject face the camera and raise the light above the center of their face.
lightingGuide.look_for_a_symmetrical_sha: Look for a symmetrical shadow under the nose. Lower the light if the shadow is too long.
lightingGuide.check_the_catchlights_befo: Check the catchlights before deciding whether to add a reflector.
lightingGuide.light_on_one_half_of_the_f: Light on one half of the face
lightingGuide.place_the_light_90_off_the: Place the light 90° off the subject’s face. Use a grid or flag to control spill onto the background.
lightingGuide.optional_a_white_reflector: Optional. A white reflector lifts shadows. A black flag cuts unwanted bounce.
lightingGuide.set_the_light_to_one_side_: Set the light to one side and ask the subject to face the camera.
lightingGuide.check_that_the_light_and_s: Check that the light and shadow split roughly down the middle. Move the light or turn the subject slightly to adjust it.
lightingGuide.move_the_reflector_back_or: Move the reflector back or remove it entirely for deeper shadows.
lightingGuide.a_large_softbox_above_the_: A large softbox above the camera provides the main light, angled down.
lightingGuide.lift_a_white_reflector_tow: Lift a white reflector toward the face from below. You can use a second soft source at lower power instead.
lightingGuide.start_with_butterfly_light: Start with butterfly lighting and put a white reflector below the chin.
lightingGuide.shoot_through_the_gap_rais: Shoot through the gap. Raise the reflector until it softens the shadows under the eyes and chin.
lightingGuide.keep_the_top_light_stronge: Keep the top light stronger to preserve shape in the face.
lightingGuide.a_soft_key_to_the_left_of_: A soft key to the left of the camera shapes the face.
lightingGuide.put_the_fill_on_the_opposi: Put the fill on the opposite side. Start about one stop below the key when metering at the subject.
lightingGuide.aim_from_behind_at_the_hai: Aim from behind at the hair and shoulders. Add a grid or flag if needed.
lightingGuide.set_exposure_for_the_key_l: Set exposure for the key light.
lightingGuide.add_fill_and_compare_the_c: Add fill and compare the contrast to the previous shot. Keep some depth in the shadows.

lightingGuide.a_warm_portrait_with_deep_: A warm portrait with deep shadows and a cool background.

parameterGuide.how_long_the_shutter_stay: How long the shutter stays open. At 1/1000 s you can freeze motion. At 1/30 s you get more light but risk blur. Use a tripod for long exposures. On the LCD, 125 means 1/125 s and 0.8″ means 0.8 s.
parameterGuide.a_lower_f_number_lets_in_: A lower f-number lets in more light and gives you a shallower depth of field. For example, f/2.8 blurs the background more than f/8. The available range depends on the lens and focal length.
parameterGuide.iso_controls_signal_gain_: ISO controls signal gain. ISO 100 produces less noise. Raising ISO lets you use a faster shutter in low light, while the amount of light reaching the sensor stays the same.
parameterGuide.adjusts_the_target_bright: Adjusts the target brightness in auto exposure. +1 EV is brighter and −1 EV is darker. In M mode, availability depends on Auto ISO and the camera.
parameterGuide.you_set_shutter_speed_ape: You set shutter speed, aperture and ISO. Manual mode is useful in the studio and for comparing presets. Change modes on the EOS 2000D using the camera’s dial.
parameterGuide.in_av_you_choose_aperture: In Av, you choose aperture and the camera sets shutter speed. In Tv, you choose shutter speed and the camera sets aperture. In P, the camera sets both. Apertrove uses the SDK to disable unavailable values.
parameterGuide.corrects_for_the_color_of: Corrects for the color of the light. Daylight, Tungsten and Custom WB help keep colors consistent between photos. In RAW, white balance is stored as a suggestion for editing.
parameterGuide.changes_contrast_sharpnes: Changes contrast, sharpness and color in JPEGs and embedded RAW previews. RAW editing profiles are separate. Apertrove presets save the camera’s Picture Style setting.
parameterGuide.one_shot_focuses_on_a_sta: One Shot focuses on a stationary subject. AI Servo tracks movement continuously. AI Focus switches behavior automatically on cameras that support it.
parameterGuide.quick_uses_dedicated_phas: Quick uses dedicated phase-detection sensors and can briefly interrupt Live View as the mirror moves. Live focuses from the sensor image. Face detection focuses on a detected face. The camera reports which methods are available.
parameterGuide.the_physical_af_mf_switch: The physical AF/MF switch may limit remote focus control. Use the switch on the lens if the camera won’t change the mode in software. Focus points come from the SDK.
parameterGuide.each_step_applies_and_che: Each step applies and checks settings, then takes one photo. A queue with unsupported settings won’t run. After finishing or stopping, Apertrove tries to restore the original settings and reports any failures.
parameterGuide.opening_the_aperture_by_o: Opening the aperture by one stop compensates for the faster shutter. Depth of field and motion blur still change.
